stops.title: Welfare and safeguarding
stops.caption: Two inboxes, deliberately separate.
stops.speech: Concerns holds two inboxes. Welfare and safeguarding are kept apart on purpose, and read by deliberately different people.

stops.title: Reading one
stops.caption: The record, and who raised it.
stops.speech: Opening a concern shows the follow-up it came from, who raised it, and what has been done about it since.
